title: Perspectives and Limitations of STEM EBIC Measurements for the Characterization of Semiconductor Devices
content: The continuous miniaturization of semiconductor devices requires characterization techniques capable of probing electronic properties with nanometer resolution. Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) combined with electron beam-induced current (EBIC) measurements have emerged as a powerful method to analyze semiconductor materials. These capabilities are critical for both fundamental semiconductor research and the optimization of device performance in industrial applications.
